notice: These profiles separate payloads by content and redistribution obligations. They are descriptive metadata, not legal advice or a replacement for the source licenses and required notices in docs/attribution.md.

attribution.description: Reuse is permitted subject to the named license and attribution or notice requirements.

share-alike.description: Adapted or redistributed material may carry ShareAlike obligations.

no-derivatives.description: Material must remain verbatim and may not be adapted under the cited license.

copyleft.description: Source-specific copyleft or font-license terms apply.

restricted.description: The source is excluded, reference-only, noncommercial, or not covered by a verified open redistribution license.

conditional.description: The effective license must be resolved from the originating or per-file asset metadata.

core.description: Queryable radical, character, word, relationship, reading, English-definition, provenance, and search data. Verbatim Taiwan definitions and binary visual assets are separate layers.

verbatim-tw-definitions.description: Exact Taiwan MOE definition cells isolated from core query records. Preserve the strings verbatim and follow CC BY-ND 3.0 Taiwan requirements.

visual-assets.description: Asset metadata and the separately manifested image and stroke-order files. License and attribution requirements vary per asset.
